messages_body:
Hi Evan + Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful conversation. Quick recap from our discovery: Hightower Bank is focused on lowering per-token inference costs for customer-facing workflows, needs predictable latency for transactional flows, and requires SOC 2 evidence and VPC deployment options for the pilot.

Next step: we'd like to run a short 30-minute product demo (high-level intro + 10–15 minute technical deep dive) to show how Redwood would fit into your architecture and review performance/SLAs. Please pick one of these slots — all times PST: 

- Thu Dec 3, 10:00–10:30 AM PST
- Thu Dec 3, 2:00–2:30 PM PST
- Sun Dec 6, 11:00–11:30 AM PST

If none work, share a couple times that do and we’ll accommodate. Attendees we recommend from our side: me (AE), Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer), and Jordan Blake (Customer Reliability).

I attached a one-page discovery summary for your reference. If there are specific integration questions (auth, VPC peering, data retention) please flag them so Marissa can prepare.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

On Nov 29, 2026, at 3:02 PM, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote: (original message content)

Sounds good — thanks for the options, Vanessa. We can do Thu Dec 3 2:00–2:30 PM PST. Please also invite our SRE and PM so they can see the architecture details: Tom Reynolds (SRE) and Priya Desai (Product). I’m copying Priya to confirm.

Quick note: we use AWS in us-west-2 and will want to confirm private deployment options and peering during the technical portion.

Thanks,

Evan Lewis
Senior Director, Platform Engineering
Hightower Bank
ev...@hightowerbank.com

Agenda (30 min):
- 0–5 min: Introductions & goals
- 5–15 min: Product demo (low-latency demos + routing)
- 15–25 min: Technical Q&A (VPC, peering, SOC 2 evidence)
- 25–30 min: Next steps & mutual action plan

Any particular data or metrics you want us to surface? Marissa — can you prepare a quick slide on peering/KMS?

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
